identity.name: Mongabay
identity.description: An independent environmental news organisation covering conservation, tropical forests, biodiversity, energy and planetary challenges through a global network of local journalists.

ownership.ownershipNotes: Independent nonprofit media organisation funded by grants, philanthropy and readers. Its global network includes local reporters and regional editions.

editorialOrientation.evidence: Nonprofit, mission-driven environmental publisher with transparent funding and a network of local reporters; no evidence of state or corporate editorial control.
editorialOrientation.source: Ownership and self-description via Official about page; secondary references; feed-level sample

politicalLeaning.evidence: No parsed MBFC ideological rating; coverage is evidence-led and environmentalist rather than aligned with a political party.

economicPerspective.evidence: Economic questions are framed through conservation, land use and sustainable development rather than a consistent market or state ideology.

internationalAlignment.evidence: Strong emphasis on tropical forests, biodiversity hotspots and communities in the Global South.
internationalAlignment.source: Ownership, editorial positioning and regional coverage sample

reliability.evidence: MBFC records High credibility; Mongabay cites scientific literature, names reporters and issues corrections.

externalRatings.notes: MBFC: credibility High; no clean bias/factual fields in the saved page (retrieved 2026-10-25).

intelligence.knownPerspective: Conservation and planetary-boundaries journalism. Explains environmental change through science, land use, local communities and policy implementation.

selectionRationale: Adds specialist environmental depth and Global South reporting that general global sources cover episodically.

research.researchNotes: Official About page confirms independent environmental newsroom. Feed-level review only; no article sample. Research is feed-level only; full article sampling and peer review remain outstanding.
